verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs say that nothing run locally ever leaves the machine, that it keeps data private, and that prompts are never tracked or trained on. Hands-on community reports corroborate fully local inference via 'ollama run' on Apple Silicon and AMD GPUs. Cloud models exist as an optional separate path, so the user must deliberately stick to local models. Missing for 10: independent verification that no telemetry or network traffic leaves the device, and documentation on how to disable or confirm the cloud path is off.
